project_description: A web-based application designed to digitalize and streamline the process of leave application, review, approval, and management for employees, managers, and HR administrators, replacing existing manual processes.

executive_summary.project_overview: The Employee Leave Management System (ELMS) is a proposed web-based application aimed at centralizing and automating the entire leave management lifecycle. It will provide functionalities for employees to apply for leave, view balances and history; for managers to review and approve/reject requests; and for HR administrators to manage employee accounts, define leave policies, update balances, and generate reports. This system is intended to significantly reduce manual paperwork and improve efficiency.
executive_summary.business_problem: Current manual processes for leave tracking involve extensive paperwork, leading to inefficiencies, errors in balance management, delays in request processing, and lack of real-time visibility for all stakeholders. This decentralized approach results in increased administrative burden on HR and management, and frustration for employees.
executive_summary.business_need: There is a critical need for a centralized, digital solution to streamline leave applications, ensure accurate tracking of leave balances, facilitate efficient managerial approval workflows, and provide comprehensive reporting capabilities. This will enhance operational efficiency, ensure compliance, and improve the overall employee experience regarding leave management.
executive_summary.proposed_solution: The proposed solution is a secure, responsive, web-based Employee Leave Management System. It will feature distinct modules tailored for Employee, Manager, and HR Administrator roles, each providing role-specific functionalities. Key components include a secure login, a dashboard for leave balances and pending requests, intuitive forms for leave application, and robust administrative tools for HR.
business_benefits: Significant reduction in manual paperwork and administrative overhead.
Improved accuracy and real-time visibility of employee leave balances.
Faster processing and decision-making for leave requests.
Enhanced transparency for employees regarding their leave status and history.
Better compliance with company leave policies through automated workflows and data validation.
Empowered employees with self-service capabilities, reducing HR inquiries.
Centralized data repository for comprehensive leave reporting and analysis.
executive_summary.expected_outcome: The successful implementation of the Employee Leave Management System will result in a fully digitalized, efficient, and user-friendly platform for managing employee leave. This will lead to increased employee satisfaction due to streamlined processes, optimized resource planning for managers, and improved data integrity and strategic insights for HR administrators, ultimately contributing to better organizational productivity and compliance.

epics.title: Employee Self-Service Leave Management
epics.business_objective: To empower employees with a secure and intuitive platform to manage their leave requests, view their entitlements, and track their leave history independently, reducing reliance on manual HR interventions.
epics.business_value: Enhances employee satisfaction and autonomy, reduces administrative burden on HR, and provides transparency regarding individual leave statuses. Contributes to a modern and efficient workplace experience.
epics.detailed_description: This epic covers all functionalities required for an employee to interact with the leave management system. It includes secure login, viewing personal leave balances, applying for various types of leave, submitting reasons and dates, and managing (e.g., canceling) their pending leave requests. Additionally, employees will be able to access a comprehensive history of all their past and current leave requests.
scope: Secure employee login and session management.
Display of available leave balances per leave type.
Submission of new leave requests with type, dates, and mandatory reason.
Ability to view and cancel pending leave requests.
Access to a personal leave history with status updates.
out_of_scope: Modification of personal profile information (e.g., department, manager assignment).
Approval or rejection of other employees' leave requests.
assumptions: Employees will have unique login credentials provided by HR.
All relevant leave types (e.g., Annual, Sick, Paternity) and associated policies will be pre-configured by HR.
Employees have access to a device with internet connectivity to use the web application.
dependencies: Centralized user authentication service.
HR module for initial employee account creation and assignment of reporting managers.
Back-end services for leave balance calculation and update.
risks: Low employee adoption if the system is not user-friendly.
Potential for data entry errors during leave application.
Security vulnerabilities if authentication mechanisms are not robust.
success_metrics: 90% of employees submit leave requests via the system within 3 months of launch.
Employee satisfaction score (related to leave management) of 4.0 out of 5.
Reduction of 25% in HR inquiries regarding employee leave balances or history.

features.title: Employee Leave Application & Management
features.description: Enables employees to initiate new leave requests, select relevant leave types, specify dates and provide reasons, and manage (e.g., cancel) any pending leave requests they have submitted.
functional_requirements: Employees shall be able to apply for leave.
Employees shall be able to select leave type.
Employees shall be able to enter leave dates.
Employees shall be able to provide leave reason.
Employees shall be able to cancel pending leave requests.
non_functional_requirements: The application interface for leave application must be intuitive and user-friendly.
All fields in the leave application form must provide clear validation messages.
Secure submission of all leave request data to prevent tampering.
technical_notes: Front-end component for leave application form and pending requests list.
API endpoint for submitting new leave requests.
API endpoint for canceling pending leave requests.
Database schema for storing leave request details (type, dates, reason, status, employee ID).
dependencies: Back-end service for leave type validation.
Back-end service for leave balance availability check (optional, can be post-submission).
Notification service for confirming submission/cancellation.
acceptance_criteria: A logged-in employee can successfully submit a new leave request.
The employee receives a confirmation message after submitting a request.
An employee can view their submitted pending requests.
An employee can successfully cancel a pending leave request, and its status changes accordingly.
Mandatory fields (leave type, dates, reason) are enforced during submission.

stories.title: Submit a New Leave Request
stories.detailed_description: As an employee, I need a clear and intuitive form to apply for leave. I should be able to select the type of leave, specify the start and end dates, and provide a mandatory reason for my absence. Upon submission, I expect a confirmation that my request has been sent for approval.
business_rules: Leave reason is mandatory for all leave types.
Start date must be on or after the current date.
End date must be on or after the start date.
Leave requests cannot exceed the maximum allowed duration for the selected leave type (if policy exists).
stories.i_want: to apply for a new leave request by selecting a type, specifying dates, and providing a reason
stories.so_that: my manager can review and approve my time off, and my leave balance can be updated accordingly.
preconditions: Employee is logged into the system.
Employee has available leave balance for the requested leave type (if real-time check is implemented).
Leave types are pre-configured in the system.
postconditions: A new leave request record is created in the system with 'Pending' status.
The employee receives an on-screen confirmation of submission.
The manager receives a notification about the new pending request.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I am logged in as an employee
WHEN I navigate to the 'Apply Leave' section
AND I fill in all mandatory fields (Leave Type, Start Date, End Date, Reason)
AND I click 'Submit'
THEN my leave request is successfully submitted with a 'Pending' status
AND I see a confirmation message 'Your leave request has been submitted successfully.'
AND the leave request appears in my 'Pending Requests' list.

tasks.title: Design and Implement Leave Application UI
tasks.description: Create the front-end user interface for the leave application form, including dropdowns for leave types, date pickers, and a text area for the reason, with client-side validation.
tasks.definition_of_done: Leave application form UI is complete and styled, including all input fields and client-side validation. Usability review passed.

tasks.title: Develop API for Leave Request Submission
tasks.description: Create a RESTful API endpoint to receive leave application data, validate server-side, store it in the database, and trigger manager notification. Includes database interaction logic.
tasks.definition_of_done: API endpoint for 'POST /api/leave/request' is developed, thoroughly unit tested, and successfully integrates with the database. Error handling is implemented.

stories.title: Cancel a Pending Leave Request
stories.detailed_description: As an employee, I might need to change my plans and withdraw a leave request that is still pending. I need to be able to easily locate my pending requests and cancel them, ensuring my manager is notified and the request is no longer awaiting action.
business_rules: Only leave requests with 'Pending' status can be canceled by the employee.
Canceled requests cannot be reinstated by the employee.
Once canceled, the request status is 'Canceled' and cannot be changed by the manager.
stories.i_want: to cancel a leave request that I have already submitted but has not yet been approved or rejected
stories.so_that: I can withdraw my request if my plans change, and it no longer appears as pending for my manager.
preconditions: Employee is logged into the system.
Employee has at least one pending leave request.
postconditions: The status of the selected leave request is updated to 'Canceled'.
The manager who was assigned to approve the request receives a notification of the cancellation.
The employee receives an on-screen confirmation of the cancellation.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I am logged in as an employee
WHEN I navigate to my 'Pending Requests' list
AND I select a pending leave request
AND I click the 'Cancel Request' button
THEN the request's status changes to 'Canceled'
AND I receive a confirmation message 'Your leave request has been canceled.'
AND the manager receives a notification of the cancellation.

tasks.title: Implement Cancel Request Button on Pending List
tasks.description: Add a 'Cancel' button or link next to each pending leave request in the employee's pending requests view. This button should trigger a confirmation dialog.
tasks.definition_of_done: Cancel button is present and functional in the UI for pending requests. Confirmation dialog is implemented.

tasks.title: Develop API for Leave Request Cancellation
tasks.description: Create a RESTful API endpoint to update the status of a specific leave request to 'Canceled'. Ensure proper authorization checks to only allow the submitting employee to cancel their own pending request.
tasks.definition_of_done: API endpoint for 'PUT /api/leave/request/{id}/cancel' is developed, unit tested, and updates the database correctly. Authorization checks are in place.

features.title: Employee Leave Information View
features.description: Provides employees with a secure means to view their current leave balances for different leave types and access a comprehensive history of all their past and current leave requests.
functional_requirements: Employees shall be able to login securely.
Employees shall be able to view available leave balance.
Employees shall be able to view leave history.
non_functional_requirements: Response time for loading leave balances and history must be below 2 seconds.
Data displayed must be accurate and up-to-date.
Role-based access control must ensure employees only see their own information.
technical_notes: API endpoint to retrieve current leave balances for a specific employee.
API endpoint to retrieve full leave history for a specific employee.
Front-end components for a leave balance dashboard and a paginated leave history table.
dependencies: Authentication service for secure login.
Backend service for calculating and storing leave balances.
Database for storing historical leave request data.
acceptance_criteria: A logged-in employee can successfully view a dashboard showing their current leave balances.
The leave balance figures are accurate and reflect all approved/rejected requests.
An employee can access a list of their past and pending leave requests.
Each item in the leave history displays relevant details (type, dates, status, reason).

stories.title: View Current Leave Balances
stories.detailed_description: As an employee, I want to easily see how many days of each leave type I currently have available. This information should be clearly displayed on my personal dashboard or a dedicated section, allowing me to plan my time off effectively without needing to contact HR.
business_rules: Leave balances are calculated based on company policy (e.g., annual accrual, carry-over rules).
Balances are updated automatically upon approval/rejection of leave requests.
stories.i_want: to see my available leave balances for all applicable leave types
stories.so_that: I can accurately plan my future leave and know how much time off I have remaining.
preconditions: Employee is logged into the system.
Employee's leave balances have been initialized by HR.
postconditions: Employee successfully views their current leave balances.
No change in system state other than displaying information.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I am logged in as an employee
WHEN I navigate to my dashboard or 'My Leave' section
THEN I see a clear display of my current balances for all assigned leave types (e.g., Annual Leave: 15 days, Sick Leave: 7 days).
AND the displayed balances are accurate and up-to-date based on all approved/rejected leave.

tasks.title: Design & Implement Leave Balance Display UI
tasks.description: Create a UI component to display current leave balances prominently on the employee dashboard. This should include a list of leave types and their corresponding available days.
tasks.definition_of_done: Leave balance display is implemented, styled, and integrated into the employee dashboard. Usability review passed.

tasks.title: Develop API for Retrieving Employee Leave Balances
tasks.description: Implement a secure API endpoint that queries the database for an authenticated employee's current leave balances across all configured leave types and returns this data.
tasks.definition_of_done: API endpoint for 'GET /api/employee/leave/balances' is developed, unit tested, and returns accurate data. Security measures for user authentication and authorization are implemented.

stories.title: Review Personal Leave History
stories.detailed_description: As an employee, I need to access a comprehensive record of all my past and current leave requests. This history should include the leave type, dates, duration, reason, and the final status (approved, rejected, pending, canceled), along with any comments from my manager if applicable.
business_rules: Leave history records should be immutable once a request status is finalized (Approved, Rejected, Canceled).
Details of rejected requests should include the manager's comment.
stories.i_want: to view a chronological list of all my past and pending leave requests
stories.so_that: I can keep track of my time off, review approval statuses, and understand my leave patterns.
preconditions: Employee is logged into the system.
Employee has submitted at least one leave request in the past.
postconditions: Employee successfully views their detailed leave history.
No change in system state other than displaying information.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I am logged in as an employee
WHEN I navigate to the 'Leave History' section
THEN I see a table or list displaying all my leave requests, sorted by date (newest first).
AND for each request, I can see: Leave Type, Start Date, End Date, Duration, Reason, and Status.
AND if a request was 'Rejected', I can also see the 'Manager Comments'.

tasks.title: Design & Implement Leave History Table UI
tasks.description: Create a responsive table component for displaying the employee's leave history, including pagination and sorting options. Ensure all required data columns are present.
tasks.definition_of_done: Leave history table UI is complete with pagination and sorting. Data display is accurate and styled. Usability review passed.

tasks.title: Develop API for Retrieving Employee Leave History
tasks.description: Implement a secure API endpoint to fetch a list of all leave requests (past and pending) for the authenticated employee from the database, including status and manager comments.
tasks.definition_of_done: API endpoint for 'GET /api/employee/leave/history' is developed, unit tested, and returns all relevant historical data. Performance is optimized for retrieving potentially large datasets.

epics.title: Managerial Leave Request Review & Approval
epics.business_objective: To provide managers with efficient tools to review, approve, or reject employee leave requests from their direct reports, ensuring timely decision-making and adherence to departmental staffing needs.
epics.business_value: Streamlines the approval workflow, reduces delays in leave processing, and ensures managers have the necessary information to make informed decisions. Improves team planning and operational continuity.
epics.detailed_description: This epic focuses on the functionalities available to managers. It includes the ability to view a consolidated list of all pending leave requests from their direct reports, review the details of each request, and then make a decision to either approve or reject it. When rejecting a request, managers will be required to provide comments for the employee's understanding. Managers will also be able to look up the leave history of their team members.
scope: Viewing a dashboard or list of pending leave requests from direct reports.
Accessing detailed information for each leave request (employee, type, dates, reason).
Ability to approve or reject a leave request.
Mandatory comments for rejecting a leave request.
Viewing individual employee leave history and balances under their supervision.
out_of_scope: Submitting leave requests on behalf of employees.
Creating or modifying organizational leave policies.
assumptions: Each employee has a single, clearly defined reporting manager in the system.
Managers will receive timely notifications for new pending leave requests.
Managers have appropriate access rights to view and act on requests from their direct reports.
dependencies: Employee module for submitting leave requests.
HR module for defining employee-manager reporting lines.
Notification service for informing employees of approval/rejection status.
risks: Delays in manager approvals impacting employee satisfaction.
Managers circumventing the system and approving/rejecting manually.
Insufficient data presented to managers leading to poor approval decisions.
success_metrics: Average time taken for manager approval/rejection reduced by 40%.
95% of managers use the system for all leave request decisions.
Manager satisfaction score (related to leave approval process) of 4.2 out of 5.

features.title: Managerial Leave Request Processing
features.description: Provides managers with a dedicated interface to efficiently review, approve, or reject incoming leave requests from their direct reports, including the capability to add comments for rejected requests.
functional_requirements: Managers shall be able to view pending leave requests.
Managers shall be able to approve requests.
Managers shall be able to reject requests.
Managers shall be able to add comments while rejecting.
non_functional_requirements: Response time for loading pending requests must be below 2 seconds.
Secure role-based access to ensure managers only see requests from their direct reports.
Intuitive UI for quick review and decision-making on requests.
technical_notes: API endpoint to retrieve all pending leave requests for a given manager.
API endpoints for updating a leave request status to 'Approved' or 'Rejected'.
Database update logic for status changes and storing rejection comments.
Notification service integration for informing employees of status changes.
dependencies: Employee module for request submission.
HR module for accurate employee-manager mapping.
Notification service for communication with employees.
acceptance_criteria: A logged-in manager can view a list of all pending leave requests from their direct reports.
The manager can approve a pending request, which updates its status to 'Approved'.
The manager can reject a pending request, providing mandatory comments, which updates its status to 'Rejected'.
Employees are notified of the approval or rejection of their requests.

stories.title: Review Pending Leave Requests
stories.detailed_description: As a manager, I need a centralized view that displays all pending leave requests submitted by my direct reports. This view should provide essential details at a glance, allowing me to quickly understand who has requested leave, for what type, and for which dates, so I can prioritize my review.
business_rules: Only requests from employees directly reporting to the logged-in manager should be displayed.
Requests should be sortable by submission date, employee name, and leave dates.
Only requests with 'Pending' status should appear in this view.
stories.i_want: to see a consolidated list of all pending leave requests from my direct reports
stories.so that: I can efficiently review them and take timely action (approve or reject).
preconditions: Manager is logged into the system.
There are pending leave requests from employees reporting to the manager.
postconditions: Manager successfully views the list of pending requests.
No change in system state other than displaying information.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I am logged in as a manager
WHEN I navigate to the 'Pending Leave Requests' section
THEN I see a list or table displaying all pending leave requests submitted by my direct reports.
AND each request displays: Employee Name, Leave Type, Start Date, End Date, Duration, and Reason.
AND the list can be sorted by various criteria.

tasks.title: Design & Implement Pending Requests Dashboard UI
tasks.description: Create the front-end dashboard for managers to view pending leave requests, including table structure, filtering options, and quick view of essential request details.
tasks.definition_of_done: Pending requests dashboard UI is complete, styled, and interactive. Displays all necessary columns and sorting/filtering options.

tasks.title: Develop API for Retrieving Manager's Pending Requests
tasks.description: Implement a secure API endpoint that fetches all pending leave requests for employees reporting to the authenticated manager. Ensure robust authorization based on the reporting structure.
tasks.definition_of_done: API endpoint for 'GET /api/manager/pending-requests' is developed, unit tested, and returns correct, authorized data. Database queries are optimized.

stories.title: Approve or Reject a Leave Request
stories.detailed_description: As a manager, after reviewing a pending leave request, I need to be able to make a clear decision to either approve or reject it. If I choose to reject, I must provide a comment explaining my decision to the employee. The system should update the request status and notify the employee accordingly.
business_rules: Rejection comments are mandatory when rejecting a leave request.
Once a request is approved or rejected, its status cannot be changed back to 'Pending'.
Only the assigned reporting manager can approve or reject a request.
stories.i_want: to approve or reject a pending leave request from an employee
stories.so that: I can manage my team's availability, ensure adequate staffing, and respond promptly to employee requests.
preconditions: Manager is logged into the system.
Manager is viewing a pending leave request from a direct report.
postconditions: The leave request's status is updated to 'Approved' or 'Rejected'.
If rejected, the manager's comment is stored with the request.
The employee who submitted the request receives a notification of the decision.
The employee's leave balance is updated (if approved).
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I am logged in as a manager
WHEN I view a pending leave request from my direct report
AND I click the 'Approve' button
THEN the request status changes to 'Approved'
AND the employee receives an approval notification.
GIVEN I am logged in as a manager
WHEN I view a pending leave request from my direct report
AND I click the 'Reject' button
AND I provide a mandatory comment in the dialog
THEN the request status changes to 'Rejected'
AND the rejection comment is saved with the request
AND the employee receives a rejection notification including the comment.

tasks.title: Implement Approve/Reject UI and Comment Dialog
tasks.description: Add 'Approve' and 'Reject' buttons to the leave request detail view for managers. Develop a modal dialog for rejection that requires a comment input.
tasks.definition_of_done: Approve/Reject buttons are functional. Rejection dialog with mandatory comment field is implemented and integrated. UI interactions are smooth.

tasks.title: Develop API for Leave Request Approval/Rejection
tasks.description: Create two API endpoints ('PUT /api/leave/request/{id}/approve' and 'PUT /api/leave/request/{id}/reject') to update request status, store rejection comments, and trigger notifications. Include logic for leave balance deduction upon approval.
tasks.definition_of_done: Approval and Rejection API endpoints are developed, unit tested, and securely update the database and trigger notifications. Leave balance update logic is correct.

features.title: Managerial Employee Leave Inquiry
features.description: Enables managers to proactively search for and view the historical leave records and current leave balances of employees under their supervision, facilitating better team planning and resource allocation.
functional_requirements: Managers shall be able to view employee leave history.
Managers shall be able to view employee current leave balances.
non_functional_requirements: Data displayed must be accurate and reflect the most current information.
Role-based access control must restrict managers to viewing only their direct reports' data.
Search and retrieval of employee leave data must be performant (e.g., < 2 seconds).
technical_notes: API endpoint to retrieve all leave history for a specific employee.
API endpoint to retrieve current leave balances for a specific employee.
Front-end search/filter component for employees under management.
Front-end display for employee-specific leave history and balances.
dependencies: HR module for establishing employee-manager reporting relationships.
Database containing all employee leave requests and balance records.
acceptance_criteria: A manager can search for a specific employee reporting to them.
The manager can view the full leave history of the selected employee.
The manager can view the current leave balances of the selected employee for each leave type.
Managers cannot access leave information for employees not reporting to them.

stories.title: View Employee Leave History for Direct Reports
stories.detailed_description: As a manager, I need to be able to access the complete leave history of any employee who directly reports to me. This detailed view, similar to the employee's own history, will help me understand their past leave patterns and inform my decisions on future leave requests or resource planning.
business_rules: Managers can only view the leave history of employees directly reporting to them.
Leave history details include type, dates, duration, reason, status, and any manager comments.
stories.i_want: to view the full leave history of a specific employee under my supervision
stories.so that: I can understand their past leave patterns and make informed decisions for future requests or resource planning.
preconditions: Manager is logged into the system.
The selected employee is a direct report of the manager.
postconditions: Manager successfully views the selected employee's detailed leave history.
No change in system state other than displaying information.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I am logged in as a manager
WHEN I navigate to 'Team Leave' or an employee search page
AND I select a direct report's profile
THEN I can access a section displaying the selected employee's full leave history.
AND the history shows: Leave Type, Start Date, End Date, Duration, Reason, and Status for all their requests.

tasks.title: Implement Employee Search and Profile View for Managers
tasks.description: Develop a search functionality for managers to find their direct reports and a basic profile view that links to their leave history and balances.
tasks.definition_of_done: Employee search is functional. Direct reports' profiles are accessible. UI for linking to history/balances is implemented.

tasks.title: Develop API for Manager to Retrieve Employee Leave History
tasks.description: Create a secure API endpoint that allows an authenticated manager to retrieve the leave history of a specified direct report, ensuring authorization checks based on reporting structure.
tasks.definition_of_done: API endpoint for 'GET /api/manager/employee/{employeeId}/leave/history' is developed, unit tested, and robustly enforces reporting line authorization. Performance is optimized.

stories.title: View Employee Current Leave Balances for Direct Reports
stories.detailed_description: As a manager, I need to easily view the current leave balances for each of my direct reports. This information is crucial for anticipating team availability, planning projects, and ensuring that employees are utilizing their leave entitlements responsibly, preventing potential operational gaps.
business_rules: Managers can only view the leave balances of employees directly reporting to them.
Displayed balances must be accurate and real-time.
stories.i_want: to view the current leave balances of my team members
stories.so that: I can assess team availability and plan projects or resource allocation effectively.
preconditions: Manager is logged into the system.
The selected employee is a direct report of the manager.
Employee's leave balances have been initialized.
postconditions: Manager successfully views the selected employee's current leave balances.
No change in system state other than displaying information.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I am logged in as a manager
WHEN I navigate to 'Team Leave' or select a direct report's profile
THEN I can access a section displaying the selected employee's current leave balances for all applicable leave types.
AND the displayed balances are accurate and up-to-date.

tasks.title: Integrate Employee Leave Balance View in Manager UI
tasks.description: Adapt the existing employee leave balance display component to be used within the manager's view for a selected direct report. Ensure proper data binding and display.
tasks.definition_of_done: Employee leave balance display is successfully integrated into the manager's team view. Data is correctly populated and displayed.

tasks.title: Develop API for Manager to Retrieve Employee Leave Balances
tasks.description: Create a secure API endpoint that allows an authenticated manager to retrieve the current leave balances of a specified direct report, ensuring strict authorization based on the reporting structure.
tasks.definition_of_done: API endpoint for 'GET /api/manager/employee/{employeeId}/leave/balances' is developed, unit tested, and securely retrieves authorized balance data. Performance is optimized.

epics.title: HR Leave Administration & Reporting
epics.business_objective: To provide HR administrators with robust tools for managing employee accounts, configuring organizational leave policies, updating leave balances, and generating comprehensive reports for strategic insights and compliance.
epics.business_value: Ensures data integrity, facilitates compliance with HR policies, provides critical data for workforce planning, and significantly reduces the manual administrative burden on HR personnel.
epics.detailed_description: This epic focuses on the administrative capabilities for HR. It encompasses the creation and management of employee user accounts, the flexibility to define and modify organizational leave policies (e.g., accrual rules, eligibility), and the ability to manually adjust individual employee leave balances when necessary. A key aspect is also the generation of organization-wide leave reports to monitor trends, ensure compliance, and support strategic decision-making.
scope: Creation, modification, and deactivation of employee user accounts.
Configuration of different leave types and their associated policies (e.g., accrual, max days).
Manual adjustment of individual employee leave balances with audit trails.
Generation and viewing of organization-wide leave reports (e.g., total leave days, departmental breakdown).
out_of_scope: Complex payroll integration (unless specified as a separate integration project).
Advanced HRIS functionalities beyond leave management.
Automated employee onboarding from an external system.
assumptions: HR administrators will have appropriate training to use the system effectively.
Clear organizational policies exist for leave management and will be provided for configuration.
Data accuracy for employee information and leave balances is critical and HR will be responsible for initial data entry/validation.
dependencies: Core database infrastructure.
Security and access control mechanisms for HR role.
Existing HR processes and policies for system configuration.
risks: Incorrect policy configuration leading to incorrect leave calculations.
Data entry errors by HR leading to inaccurate employee records.
System performance degradation when generating large organization-wide reports.
Security breaches for sensitive HR and employee data.
success_metrics: 100% accuracy of configured leave policies against official HR documents.
Reduction of 50% in manual efforts for managing employee leave balances.
All required organization-wide leave reports are available and accurate within 5 seconds.

features.title: HR Employee and Policy Management
features.description: Enables HR administrators to create and manage employee accounts within the system, update individual leave balances, and configure organizational leave policies such as types, accrual rates, and eligibility rules.
functional_requirements: HR administrators shall be able to create employee accounts.
HR administrators shall be able to modify leave policies.
HR administrators shall be able to update leave balances.
non_functional_requirements: Secure authentication and role-based access for HR administrators.
All changes to leave policies and balances must be recorded in an audit log.
User interface for HR tasks must be clear and prevent accidental data entry errors.
technical_notes: API endpoints for creating, updating, deactivating employee accounts.
API endpoints for managing leave types and their policy parameters.
API endpoints for adjusting individual employee leave balances.
Database schema for audit logging of HR actions.
dependencies: User management and authentication services.
Database for storing employee data, leave policies, and balances.
acceptance_criteria: An HR administrator can successfully create a new employee account with required details.
An HR administrator can modify an existing employee's details (e.g., manager, department).
An HR administrator can define or update parameters for a specific leave type.
An HR administrator can manually adjust an employee's leave balance for any leave type.
All policy and balance changes are recorded in an audit trail.

stories.title: Manage Employee User Accounts
stories.detailed_description: As an HR Administrator, I need the ability to create new employee accounts, modify existing employee details (such as their assigned manager or department), and deactivate accounts for employees who leave the organization. This ensures that only active employees have system access and accurate reporting structures are maintained.
business_rules: Employee ID must be unique.
Mandatory fields for employee creation include (at minimum) Name, Employee ID, Department, and Reporting Manager.
Deactivating an employee account should prevent login but retain historical data.
stories.i_want: to create, update, and deactivate employee accounts within the leave management system
stories.so that: all employees have access to the system, and user data remains current and secure.
preconditions: HR Administrator is logged into the system with appropriate permissions.
postconditions: A new employee account is created and accessible.
An existing employee's details are updated successfully.
An employee account is deactivated, preventing login while preserving data.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I am logged in as an HR Administrator
WHEN I navigate to 'Employee Management'
AND I click 'Create New Employee'
AND I fill in all mandatory fields and submit
THEN a new employee account is created successfully.
GIVEN I am logged in as an HR Administrator
WHEN I select an existing employee
AND I modify their 'Reporting Manager' and save
THEN the employee's reporting manager is updated.
GIVEN I am logged in as an HR Administrator
WHEN I select an active employee
AND I choose 'Deactivate Account'
THEN the employee can no longer log in, but their data remains accessible for reporting.

tasks.title: Design & Implement HR Employee Management UI
tasks.description: Create UI for HR to create, view, edit, and deactivate employee accounts. This includes forms for new employees and a searchable table for existing ones.
tasks.definition_of_done: Employee management UI is complete, allowing HR to perform all specified actions. Client-side validation is robust.

tasks.title: Develop API for HR Employee CRUD Operations
tasks.description: Implement secure API endpoints for creating (POST), retrieving (GET), updating (PUT), and deactivating (PUT) employee user accounts, including associated reporting structures.
tasks.definition_of_done: CRUD API endpoints for employee accounts are developed, unit tested, and secure. Database interactions are efficient. Deactivation logic is correctly implemented.

stories.title: Configure Leave Policies and Balances
stories.detailed_description: As an HR Administrator, I need full control over configuring the various leave types offered by the company, including their accrual rates, maximum limits, and eligibility rules. Additionally, I require the ability to manually adjust individual employee leave balances in special circumstances, with all such adjustments being logged for audit purposes.
business_rules: Changes to leave policies should take effect from a specified date.
All manual adjustments to leave balances must include a reason and be recorded in an audit trail.
Leave balances reset annually (as per assumption).
stories.i_want: to configure organizational leave policies (e.g., accrual rates, eligibility) and manually adjust individual employee leave balances
stories.so that: the system accurately reflects company policies and employees' entitlements.
preconditions: HR Administrator is logged into the system with appropriate permissions.
postconditions: Leave policies are updated and reflected in the system for future calculations.
An employee's leave balance is manually adjusted, and the adjustment is logged.
All changes are traceable via an audit log.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I am logged in as an HR Administrator
WHEN I navigate to 'Leave Policy Configuration'
AND I create/modify a leave type (e.g., Annual Leave accrual to 2 days/month)
THEN the policy changes are saved and applied to new calculations.
GIVEN I am logged in as an HR Administrator
WHEN I search for an employee and access their 'Leave Balances' section
AND I enter a new balance value for 'Sick Leave' along with a mandatory reason
THEN the employee's sick leave balance is updated
AND an entry is added to the audit log detailing the change, reason, and HR user.

tasks.title: Design & Implement Leave Policy Configuration UI
tasks.description: Create UI for HR to define and modify leave types, accrual rules, maximum limits, and other policy parameters. This should include forms for adding new policies and editing existing ones.
tasks.definition_of_done: Leave policy configuration UI is complete and allows HR to manage all specified policy parameters. Client-side validation is present.

tasks.title: Develop API for Leave Policy & Balance Management with Audit
tasks.description: Implement secure API endpoints for managing leave policies (CRUD) and for manual adjustment of employee leave balances. Crucially, integrate a comprehensive audit logging mechanism for all balance adjustments and policy changes.
tasks.definition_of_done: API endpoints for 'POST/PUT /api/hr/policies' and 'PUT /api/hr/employee/{id}/balance' are developed, unit tested, and secure. Audit logging is fully implemented for all relevant actions.

features.title: HR Organization-Wide Reporting
features.description: Provides HR administrators with comprehensive tools to generate and view various reports on leave utilization across the entire organization, including aggregated data, customizable filters, and export options, to support strategic workforce planning and compliance.
functional_requirements: HR administrators shall be able to view organization-wide leave reports.
non_functional_requirements: Reports must be generated accurately based on system data.
Report generation performance should be optimized for large datasets (< 5 seconds for common reports).
Data in reports must be secure and only accessible to authorized HR users.
Reports should be exportable in common formats (e.g., CSV, PDF).
technical_notes: API endpoints for generating various types of aggregate leave reports.
Database queries optimized for complex reporting needs (e.g., joins, aggregations).
Front-end report viewer with filtering, sorting, and export capabilities.
Libraries/services for PDF/CSV generation.
dependencies: Comprehensive and accurate leave request and employee data in the database.
acceptance_criteria: An HR administrator can select a date range and generate a report of total leave days taken by type.
The generated report accurately reflects the data and can be filtered by department.
The HR administrator can export any generated report to CSV or PDF format.
The system displays key aggregate leave statistics on a dashboard (e.g., total annual leave taken across company).

stories.title: Generate Organization-Wide Leave Reports
stories.detailed_description: As an HR Administrator, I need to generate detailed reports that provide a holistic view of leave utilization across the entire organization. These reports should allow me to filter by various parameters like date range, department, or leave type, and ideally be exportable for further analysis or presentations.
business_rules: Report data must be sourced directly from the system's leave records.
Reports should be capable of filtering by date range, department, and leave type.
Reports must be exportable to at least CSV format.
Data presented must adhere to all data privacy regulations (e.g., no sensitive individual reasons).
stories.i_want: to generate reports showing aggregated leave data across the entire organization
stories.so that: I can analyze leave trends, ensure compliance, and support strategic workforce planning.
preconditions: HR Administrator is logged into the system with appropriate permissions.
Sufficient leave data exists in the system to generate meaningful reports.
postconditions: A report is successfully generated and displayed on-screen.
The report can be exported to CSV/PDF.
Insights into organizational leave patterns are made available.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I am logged in as an HR Administrator
WHEN I navigate to the 'Reports' section
AND I select 'Total Leave Days by Type' report
AND I specify a date range (e.g., Jan 1 - Dec 31)
THEN a report is generated showing total days taken for each leave type within that period.
AND I can apply a filter by 'Department' to this report.
AND I can click 'Export to CSV' to download the report data.

tasks.title: Design & Implement Report Selection and Viewer UI
tasks.description: Create a UI for HR administrators to select different report types, specify filters (date range, department), and display the generated report data in a tabular format. Include export buttons.
tasks.definition_of_done: Report selection and viewer UI is complete and interactive. Filters are functional. Export buttons are present.

tasks.title: Develop API for Organization-Wide Leave Reports
tasks.description: Implement secure API endpoints for generating various aggregate leave reports (e.g., total days by type, departmental breakdown). Optimize database queries for performance with large datasets and implement data export functionalities.
tasks.definition_of_done: Reporting API endpoints are developed, unit tested, and performant. Database queries are optimized. CSV/PDF export logic is implemented and integrated.

stories.title: View Aggregate Leave Statistics
stories.detailed_description: As an HR Administrator, beyond detailed reports, I need a quick overview of key aggregate leave statistics, potentially presented through charts or summary dashboards. This will allow me to rapidly identify trends, utilization rates, and any significant outliers that might require further investigation or policy adjustments.
business_rules: Statistics should be based on finalized leave requests (Approved, Rejected, Canceled).
Data displayed must be refreshed daily or upon request.
No individual employee data should be visible in aggregate statistics.
stories.i_want: to view key statistical summaries of leave usage within the organization
stories.so that: I can quickly grasp overall leave patterns and identify potential areas for further investigation or policy adjustments.
preconditions: HR Administrator is logged into the system with appropriate permissions.
postconditions: Aggregate leave statistics are successfully displayed.
HR gains a quick understanding of overall leave patterns.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN I am logged in as an HR Administrator
WHEN I navigate to the HR dashboard
THEN I see summary statistics such as 'Total Annual Leave Taken (YTD)', 'Average Sick Leave Per Employee', and 'Leave Breakdown by Department (Chart)'.
AND these statistics are based on the latest available data.

tasks.title: Design & Implement HR Statistics Dashboard UI
tasks.description: Create a dedicated dashboard UI for HR administrators to display key aggregate leave statistics using charts (e.g., bar charts for leave types, pie charts for departmental breakdown) and summary cards.
tasks.definition_of_done: HR statistics dashboard UI is complete, interactive, and visually appealing. All required summary data and charts are displayed correctly.

tasks.title: Develop API for Aggregate Leave Statistics
tasks.description: Implement secure API endpoints to calculate and return various aggregate leave statistics for the entire organization, optimized for quick retrieval and dashboard display.
tasks.definition_of_done: API endpoints for 'GET /api/hr/statistics' are developed, unit tested, and performant. Data aggregation logic is correct and robust.

non_functional_requirements.performance: Application response time for all user interactions (page loads, form submissions, data retrieval) must be consistently below 2 seconds, especially for critical workflows like leave application and request review. Report generation for large datasets should not exceed 5 seconds.
non_functional_requirements.security: Robust security measures including secure authentication (e.g., OAuth2, JWT), role-based access control (RBAC) ensuring users only access authorized data and functionalities, and protection against common web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10). All data at rest and in transit must be encrypted. A comprehensive audit trail for sensitive actions (e.g., HR updating balances) must be maintained.
non_functional_requirements.availability: The system must be available 99.5% of the time during business hours (08:00 - 18:00 local time, Monday to Friday). This includes provisions for quick recovery from failures and planned maintenance windows with minimal disruption. Daily automated database backups are required to prevent data loss.
non_functional_requirements.scalability: The system must be scalable to support up to 5,000 employees and process approximately 1,000 leave requests per day without degradation in performance. The architecture should allow for horizontal scaling of application servers and database capacity as user numbers grow.
non_functional_requirements.reliability: All core functionalities (leave application, approval, balance updates, reporting) must execute consistently and without errors. Data integrity must be maintained across all transactions, ensuring that leave balances and request statuses are always accurate. The system should gracefully handle unexpected errors and provide informative messages to users without exposing sensitive system details.
